# AwakeProd

> AwakeProd is the trade name of Julien Raulot, an independent developer in France who makes iPhone apps.

## Molette

Molette is an iPhone music player for your own files, with a clicking wheel like a 2000s pocket player.
- Plays MP3, AAC, M4A, ALAC, FLAC, WAV, AIFF and CAF, gapless, offline.
- No account, no server, no ads, no data collected. Music is copied in with Finder, Apple Devices on Windows, or the Files app.
- Free for the first 25 albums. Unlimited is a one-time in-app purchase (not a subscription): every album, Clean Up Names, seven colored cases, a Home Screen widget.
- iOS 17 or later. Interface in 15 languages.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6834086865
- [Molette (English)](https://www.awakeprod.fr/molette/): features and FAQ
- [Molette (français)](https://www.awakeprod.fr/molette/fr/)
- [Support](https://www.awakeprod.fr/molette/support/): adding music, formats, restoring a purchase
- [Privacy](https://www.awakeprod.fr/molette/privacy/): Molette collects no data

## NITRODRIVE

NITRODRIVE is an arcade racing game for iPhone, played in portrait with one thumb. The point of the game is the takedown: ramming rivals into the walls and the traffic.
- Controls: slide the thumb to steer (the throttle is automatic); hold into a tight bend to drift and charge a turbo; lift to fire the turbo; double tap to boost (gauge a third full); triple tap for NITRO (gauge full); a short tap uses the item picked up. If you crash, you get one second to steer your wreck into a rival.
- 20 city circuits, among them NEON, RIVIERA, CANYON, SHIBUYA, MANHATTAN, ROME, THAMES, TOY ROOM and ORBIT. 9 cars, from a hatchback to a formula car.
- Price: License C is free (four circuits, their cup, time trials and free runs). One in-app purchase of 4.99 USD ("Full Game", non-consumable, Family Sharing included) unlocks licenses B, A and S for good: 12 more circuits right away, and the cars, the PRO cup and its 4 circuits as you earn stars. Nothing else to buy, ever. No subscription, no ads, no energy, no loot boxes, no account.
- Every day: a daily challenge on a new circuit with a world board; a world top 5 on every time trial; ghosts to race; challenge links to send a friend.
- Offline: everything works without a connection except the world boards.
- Privacy: no account, no ads, no analytics. The world boards receive a nickname, a random id created by the game, a country code, the circuit, the score and the ghost, only when you finish a daily challenge or beat a time-trial record.
- Languages: English and French. iOS 15 or later. Made in France with Godot Engine by Julien Raulot (AwakeProd). iPhone first; Android later.
- App Store: not yet available (coming soon).
- [NITRODRIVE (English)](https://www.awakeprod.fr/nitrodrive/): screenshots, features, price and FAQ
- [NITRODRIVE (français)](https://www.awakeprod.fr/nitrodrive/fr/)
- [Support](https://www.awakeprod.fr/nitrodrive/support/): controls, restoring a purchase, boards and ghosts, deleting your data
- [Privacy](https://www.awakeprod.fr/nitrodrive/privacy/): what the world boards receive, what stays on the phone
